notes: *thou* answers to the expressed σε rather than being supplied, so rule 74 is not in question; the complementizer *that* sits with the infinitive under rule 85.
Both privative adjectives head on their nouns (*spot*, *reproach*) under rule 84's unbroken line, *without* spelling only the alpha-privative.
τοῦ before κυρίου is `unrepresented` under rule 20, ἡμῶν carrying the possessive; the case preposition *of* stays with the noun discontinuously.
